hh_ethnologue_comment.comment:
E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 has a separate entry for Djabwurrung
[tjw]. But Djabwurrung belongs to a large set of named varieties close enough to be the same language which may be called Western Victoria
(**hh:hew:Mathews:Aboriginal-New-South-Wales**, **hh:hvw:Waferetal:New-South-Wales**, **hh:hv:BlakeReid:Victorian**).
